item.tib: yang zab rdzogs pa chen po yi mkha' 'gro snying gi thig le las mngon sum rig pa'i rang sgra
item.coloph: ces rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud las/ mngon sum rig pa'i rang sgra 'di ni/ zhing skyongs mi yi dbang po rab brten rgyal po sku mched kyi zhabs bltos cher cher sgrub pa dang*/ rigs mthun 'gro ba bzang mo dkar (rka) ma spos dri can gyi bsgrabs sder mdzad pa dang*/ phyi ma'i don du gnyer ba snying gi bu mchog bka' yi rgyud la phan sems dang bcas te/ phyogs med sprang du 'khyams pa'i rgyal khams pa/ kun grol grags pas dus kyi pho nya'i sa gzhi bcud dang ldan pa'i dus su/ dga' ldan g.yung drung gling gi dbu rtser phab pa'o//
